title: clinical data manager
note: example row - data management is not a clinical role. REJECT needs no title_group; it only unassigns the value.

title: doctoral researcher
note: 42,231 records. Won 'student' over 'researcher_early' by 0.018 and student supports no role, so every one of them was dropped. A doctoral researcher is a researcher.

title: research intern
note: 28,124 records. Won 'trainee_clinical' by 0.018, which routed research interns into HCP. A research internship is not a clinical traineeship.

title: research group leader
note: 10,200 records. Won 'support_technical' by 0.012 and support_technical supports no role. Runner-up was researcher_early; established is the better fit for someone leading a group.

title: biostatistician
note: 7,723 records. Won 'support_technical' by 0.002 and support_technical supports no role. Biostatistics is research.

title: chair professor
note: 6,338 records, margin 0.000 - a true tie. Won 'leadership', which put it in faculty_head and hcp_administrator. In Hong Kong and much of Asia a Chair Professor is a senior professorship, not a head of department.

title: visiting phd student
note: 5,906 records. Won 'teaching_academic' by 0.001, which labelled visiting doctoral students as lecturers. They are students; student supports no role and that is the correct outcome.

title: visiting researcher
note: 67,191 records, the largest single item in the queue. Was teaching_academic, so it fed lecturer; it matched the anchor 'visiting professor'. A visiting researcher researches - the word is in the title.

title: member
note: 23,157 records. Was teaching_academic via the anchor 'faculty member', matching one word out of two. 'Member' alone carries no occupational information at all, so it is rejected rather than reassigned.

title: research associate professor
note: 12,374 records. Was teaching_academic. In US usage this is a non-tenure research-track faculty title, and 'research professor' with 48,609 records is already researcher_established - so this is consistency as well as meaning.

title: undergraduate researcher
note: 6,342 records. Was researcher_early, feeding researcher and hcp_researcher. An undergraduate is not employed as a researcher anywhere, and 'student researcher' with 5,988 records is already student - so this is consistency as well as meaning.

title: guest scientist
note: 5,877 records. Was teaching_academic via 'visiting professor'. A guest scientist is a researcher.

title: editorial board member
note: 5,535 records. Was teaching_academic via 'faculty member', again on the word 'member'. Serving on an editorial board is not employment as teaching staff and is not an occupation.
